## Runs 6 + 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`): electron n = +3.2×10¹² (run 6, 0 → 10 T) and hole n = −1.2×10¹² (run 7, 10 → 0.3 T)

Raw first (top row), then the background-subtracted 1/B record with the `sdh_onset` read, then the FFT stability sweep (cutoff × bg-degree × window) against F_L and the forward model's ABAB pair (`tetralayer_fs_count`). Channel arithmetic R = (sr1_X/1)/(sr0_X/−1e6); run 6's onset read excludes its 50 mT leg (0–1 T), which is Nyquist-blind to a 7 T tone below ~1 T.

**Read — run 6 (electron):** one dominant fundamental **7.3 T** (SNR ≈ 100, *censored* at 1.0 T — alive at the record edge, so the onset is < 1 T, unmeasured) with an exact harmonic comb 14.8 / 22.3 / 29.4 / 58.6 T; the ~29.5–30 T tone dominates the ≥ 3 T window (LK-consistent with a heavier carrier appearing at high B, *or* simply the 4th harmonic sharpening as the minima deepen — the raw trace shows QH-like minima near 0 Ω from ~2 T). Peak set is stable across cutoff/degree/window (positions move < 0.5 T). Model at n = +3.2: ABAB 7.3 + 25.8 T (m* 0.027 / 0.061), ABCA 33.1 T (m* 0.074). **The set is degenerate:** {7.5, 22.5, 30} = harmonic comb of a single 0.72×10¹² pocket, *or* an ABAB pair 7.5 + 22.5 with its sum/breakdown tone at F_L under a lever-arm scale 0.90 (partition 0.25/0.75 vs model 0.22/0.78 at n = 2.9). That is the ratio-≈3 trap the investigation flags; the decider is the **n-dependence** (fan) — a harmonic tracks k·f exactly, a real heavy pocket tracks its own Onsager curve (model slopes 9.4 vs 7.3 T per 10¹² for 3×light vs heavy, diverging to 4–7 T separation at n = 1.5–2). No ABCA singleton at 33 T at scale 1; a 30 T tone at scale 0.9 remains a live F_L-tone-origin question. Above 7.7 T R climbs to ~500 Ω (ν ≈ 13–17 QH structure) — outside the FFT band.

**Read — run 7 (hole):** messier: 6.8 T (strong, censored at 0.5 T), 12.3 T (strong above 1.7 T, at F_L = 12.4), plus 4.6 / 8.5 / 15.8 T. Model: the near-CNP ABAB pair is close and balanced (5.9 + 6.5 T, unresolvable at this record's δF ≈ 0.5–2 T), ABCA 12.4 T with m* ≈ 1.1 (LK-dead at T_e ≈ 8 K — a 12.3 T tone is therefore *not* naturally an ABCA singleton; a 2× of ~6.2 or a pair sum are the candidates). This is the recipe's low-|n| exception regime by construction (the hole side of the D = 0 line reaches only −1.27×10¹² inside the validators) — recorded, not read further. **Side call: electron.**

**Handed to the fan:** sensitivity/τ (50 µV → 100 µV for the low-n corner headroom; τ 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct), Δ(1/B) ≤ 1/(3·F_L(n_max)), onset pending the low-field extension (run 8).

"""Runs 6 + 7 — sdh-spot-check read (electron n=+3.2e12, hole n=-1.2e12; D = 0, run-5 cal): raw R(B), background-
subtracted 1/B record, sdh_onset per run, FFT stability sweep, forward-model F(n) (tetralayer_fs_count) at each spot."""
import sys, warnings
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.signal import find_peaks
import hera
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, SdhOnsetError, sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency
_MODEL_DIR = Path(hera.__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "hera" / "models" / "tetralayer_fs_count"   # <repo>/hera/models/... via the installed package, OS-agnostic
assert _MODEL_DIR.is_dir(), _MODEL_DIR
sys.path.insert(0, str(_MODEL_DIR))
import fs_count_b0 as fsm

def trace(i):
    r = run(i); B = r.col("magnet_field"); R = (r.col("sr1_X") / 1.0) / (r.col("sr0_X") / -1e6)
    o = np.argsort(B); return B[o], R[o], r

spots = [(6, 3.2, 1.0), (7, -1.2, 0.5)]        # (run, n [1e12], b_lo for the onset read: run 6's 0-1 T leg is 50 mT-stepped -> Nyquist-blind, excluded)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
for col, (rid, n12, blo) in enumerate(spots):
    B, R, r = trace(rid); FL = luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16); Bmax = B.max()
    _, orbs = fsm.abab_fs(n12 * 1e16); ms = fsm.abab_mstar(n12 * 1e16); *_, Fabca = fsm.abca_fs(n12 * 1e16); _, mabca = fsm.abca_mstar(n12 * 1e16)
    print(f"\n=== run {rid}: n = {n12:+.2f}e12, F_L = {FL:.1f} T | model ABAB " + ", ".join(f"{F:.1f} T (m* {mm:.3f})" for (F, _), (_, mm) in zip(orbs, ms))
          + f" | ABCA {Fabca:.1f} T (m* {mabca:.3f}) | R {R.min():.0f}..{R.max():.0f} Ohm")
    ax = axes[0, col]; ax.plot(B, R, lw=0.7, color="k"); ax.set_title(f"run {rid} raw Rxx (sr1/sr0), n = {n12:+.1f}e12, D = 0"); ax.set_xlabel("B (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("Rxx (Ohm)")
    sel = B >= blo - 1e-6
    with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as w:
        warnings.simplefilter("always")
        try:
            on = sdh_onset(R[sel], B[sel], r_full_scale=50e-6 / 10e-9); onset_b = on.onset_b
            for ww in w: print("  warn:", ww.message)
            print(on.summary())
        except SdhOnsetError as e:
            print("  SdhOnsetError:", e); onset_b = None
    p = np.polyfit(B[sel], R[sel], 5); dR = R[sel] - np.polyval(p, B[sel])
    ax = axes[1, col]; ax.plot(1 / B[sel], dR, lw=0.7); ax.set_xlabel("1/B (1/T)"); ax.set_ylabel(f"dRxx (Ohm), deg-5 bg in B, B >= {blo} T")
    if onset_b: ax.axvline(1 / onset_b, color="r", ls="--", label=f"sdh_onset {onset_b:.2f} T"); ax.legend()
    ax = axes[2, col]
    for cut, deg, win, c in [(blo, 5, "hann", "k"), (2.0, 5, "hann", "C0"), (3.0, 5, "hann", "C1"), (2.0, 3, "hann", "C2"), (2.0, 7, "hann", "C3"), (2.0, 5, None, "C4")]:
        f, s = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cut, Bmax), bg_degree=deg, window=win, log=False, nfft=4096)
        s = s[0]; mf = (f > 1.5) & (f < 2.2 * FL); ax.plot(f[mf], s[mf] / s[mf].max(), lw=0.8, color=c, label=f"cut {cut:.1f} T, deg {deg}, {win}")
        if deg == 5 and win == "hann":
            pk, _ = find_peaks(s[mf], prominence=0.1 * s[mf].max())
            print(f"  FFT [{cut:.1f}, {Bmax:.0f}] T (dF {1/(1/cut-1/Bmax):.2f} T): " + ", ".join(f"{f[mf][q]:.1f} T ({s[mf][q]/s[mf][pk].max():.2f})" for q in sorted(pk, key=lambda q: -s[mf][q])[:6]))
    for x, lab, ls in ((FL, "F_L", ":"), (orbs[-1][0], "ABAB heavy (model)", "--"), (orbs[0][0], "ABAB light (model)", "-.")):
        ax.axvline(x, color="m" if lab == "F_L" else "g", ls=ls, label=lab)
    ax.set_xlabel("F (T)"); ax.set_ylabel("|FFT| (norm)"); ax.set_xlim(0, 2.2 * FL); ax.legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout(); plt.show()

## HERA — Fan prep: low-field onset extension at the electron spot (`sdh-spot-check` Verify → `landau-fan` step-1 lever 1)

> **05:27** · low-field onset extension, electron spot n=+3.2e12 D=0: B 0.2->1.05 T 5 mT (171 pts), sr1 50 uV, dwell = 3 s driver settle; pins run 6's censored onset -> fan B\_lo · **ETA ~05:42** (≈15 min)

**Spot-check read (runs 6/7, ana):** electron side (run 6, n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T) is the clean side — one dominant fundamental at **7.3 T** (SNR ~100) with an exact harmonic comb 14.8 / 22.3 / 29.4 T, the 29–30 T tone dominating above 3 T (plus 58.6 = 8×). Model at this n: ABAB pair 7.3 + 25.8 T, ABCA singleton 33.1 T. The set {7.5, 22.5, 30} is *degenerate* between "harmonic comb of one 0.72×10¹² pocket" and "ABAB pair (7.5 + 22.5) + its sum/breakdown tone at F_L with lever-arm scale 0.9" — exactly the ratio-≈3 trap the investigation names; only the **n-dependence** (harmonics track k·f exactly, a real pocket follows its own Onsager curve) breaks it → the fan. Hole side (run 7, n = −1.2×10¹²) is the low-|n| exception regime (close/balanced ABAB pair 5.9 + 6.5 T predicted) and reads messy (6.8, 4.6, 8.5, 12.3, 15.8 T) — not the fan side.

**Why this cell first:** run 6's carrying tone is **censored at 1.0 T** (`sdh_onset`, alive at the record's low edge; the 0–1 T leg was 50 mT-stepped — Nyquist-blind to a 7 T tone below ~1 T). Per `landau-fan` step 1, a censored onset is a lower bound and a cheap low-field extension pins it before committing the long fan: the fan's rows between 0.7 and 1.0 T alone cost ~2 h (43 of 135 uniform-1/B rows), so this 10-minute sweep decides them. It also serves as the grid-change reproduction of the 7.3 T tone (5 mT vs 10 mT uniform-B). Magnet rides up from 0 T (handoff state) — no re-traverse; ends at 1.05 T with the gates at the spot, where the fan positions itself.

**Preconditions read in-cell:** T_sample 1.0–1.5 K (logfile live), |B| < 0.05 T, V_si = 0, PS heater on / output enabled. Sensitivity 50 µV as in runs 6/7. Checkpoint: first 20 points (R ≈ 15–60 Ω, leakage < 1 nA, field tracking); read at completion → fan B_lo.

# === Low-field onset extension at the electron spot (`sdh-spot-check` Verify / `landau-fan` step-1 lever 1): n = +3.2e12, D = 0, B 0.2 -> 1.05 T at 5 mT ===
# Run 6's 7.3 T tone is CENSORED at 1.0 T (alive at the edge of the 10 mT leg; the 0-1 T leg was 50 mT-stepped,
# Nyquist-blind to a 7 T tone below ~1 T). This pins the onset with a proper grid before the fan's B_lo is committed,
# and doubles as the grid-change reproduction (5 mT uniform-B vs run 6's 10 mT) for the 7.3 T tone.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)   # run-5 calibration (ana)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set): base T, magnet at 0 (handoff readback), Si 0, PS/output on ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: sweep starts near 0), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()

B_vec = np.round(np.arange(0.2, 1.0501, 0.005), 4)          # 171 pts; dInvB at 0.3 T = 0.056/T (Nyq 9 T), at 0.5 T 0.02/T (Nyq 25 T)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)                                        # same as runs 6/7 (5 kOhm FS); R here is 10-60 Ohm
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts, {B_vec[0]} -> {B_vec[-1]} T, 5 mT; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr1.time_constant()} s, slope {sr1.filter_slope()} dB/oct; dwell = driver settle {magnet.settle_s} s")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = f"low-field onset extension at the electron spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = 0 (run-5 cal), (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.2 -> 1.05 T 5 mT, sr1 50 uV; pins run 6's censored onset before the fan"
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'low-field onset extension, electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0.2 -> 1.05 T uniform-B 5 mT; follows run 6 (7.3 T tone censored at 1.0 T); cal run 5')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field stays at 1.05 T — the fan positions itself from here (B_lo from this run's onset).
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f}), T_sample = {T_sample():.3f} K")
